chains.title: Alt T allele creates a C/EBP (CEBPB) site that activates the SORT1 liver enhancer, raising SORT1 and lowering LDL
chains.element: Liver enhancer within the 1p13 CELSR2/PSRC1/SORT1 locus containing rs12740374

links.claim: The minor T allele generates a C/EBP-family recognition sequence, so the alt allele is bound more strongly than ref; within the C/EBP specificity group CEBPB is chosen because it is highly expressed in hepatocytes and hepatoma lines and has ChIP-seq occupancy at this locus in liver.
The variant sits in a hepatocyte-active enhancer; creation of the C/EBP site increases enhancer activity on the alt allele.
Increased enhancer activity raises SORT1 transcription in cis (the locus is a strong liver eQTL for SORT1).
The effect is hepatocyte-restricted, matching liver-specific C/EBP activity and SORT1 expression.
Higher hepatic SORT1 increases clearance/reduced secretion of apoB-containing lipoproteins, lowering plasma LDL-C and myocardial infarction risk.

predictions: Allele-specific C/EBP ChIP (CEBPB) in liver/HepG2-like cells shows preferential occupancy of the T allele
Luciferase reporter: T allele enhancer gives higher activity in hepatocytes, abolished by mutating the C/EBP core
CEBPB knockdown reduces SORT1 expression specifically on the T-allele background
CRISPR deletion of the element lowers SORT1 mRNA in hepatocytes but not in non-hepatic cells
falsified_if: No allelic difference in C/EBP binding by EMSA/ChIP
Reporter shows no T>G activity difference in hepatocytes

chains.title: Null: rs12740374 has no TF-mediated allelic effect; association is driven by a linked variant in the 1p13 haplotype
predictions: No allelic difference in reporter assay or allele-specific ChIP at this position
Base editing of rs12740374 alone in hepatocytes leaves SORT1 expression unchanged
Another variant on the haplotype shows the allelic activity
falsified_if: Single-base editing of rs12740374 changes SORT1 expression
Allele-specific TF binding is demonstrated at this position

chains.title: The created site is bound by a different C/EBP-group member, CEBPA, which drives the same SORT1 enhancer

links.claim: The alt T allele creates the shared C/EBP motif; CEBPA is selected within the group as the dominant constitutive C/EBP in differentiated hepatocytes, which may matter more than CEBPB in vivo.
CEBPA binding to the alt allele activates the enhancer.
SORT1 transcription increases in cis.
Restricted to hepatocytes where CEBPA is abundant; hepatoma lines with low CEBPA would show a weaker effect.
Higher SORT1 lowers LDL-C and MI risk.

predictions: CEBPA knockdown, not CEBPB knockdown, abolishes the allelic difference
Allelic effect is weaker in hepatoma lines with low CEBPA and restored by CEBPA re-expression
falsified_if: CEBPA depletion has no effect on SORT1 while CEBPB depletion does
CEBPA ChIP shows no occupancy at the element

chains.title: Alt allele increases binding of a hepatic nuclear receptor/HNF factor rather than C/EBP, altering SORT1

links.claim: The sequence change could instead improve an HNF4A half-site; HNF4A is chosen among liver nuclear receptors because it is the dominant hepatocyte regulator with widespread enhancer occupancy.
HNF4A binding raises element activity on the alt allele.
SORT1 expression increases in cis.
Effect limited to HNF4A-expressing hepatocytes.
Raised SORT1 lowers plasma LDL-C and MI risk.

predictions: HNF4A ChIP shows allele-preferential binding at the element
HNF4A knockdown abolishes the allelic reporter difference while C/EBP knockdown does not
Mutating a predicted HNF4A half-site, not the C/EBP core, removes the allelic effect
falsified_if: No HNF4A occupancy at the element
Mutating the C/EBP core alone abolishes the allelic effect

chains.title: Alt allele acts through a repressor whose binding is lost, with the net effect on a neighbouring gene (CELSR2/PSRC1) rather than SORT1
chains.element: 1p13 element at rs12740374 acting on the CELSR2/PSRC1 promoter region

links.claim: Alternatively the ref G allele is the better-bound state for a C/EBP-like repressive isoform (e.g. LIP form of CEBPB), so binding is lost on the alt allele.
Loss of repressor binding de-represses the element on the alt allele.
The de-repressed element acts mainly on CELSR2/PSRC1, which are also strong eQTL targets at this locus.
Effect confined to liver where the locus is active.
Altered CELSR2/PSRC1 levels change hepatic lipoprotein handling and LDL-C.

predictions: Allele-specific expression at the locus is seen for CELSR2/PSRC1 but not SORT1
SORT1 knockdown does not reproduce the lipid phenotype in hepatocyte models
Reporter shows higher activity for alt via loss of a repressor footprint
falsified_if: Enhancer deletion changes only SORT1 and not CELSR2/PSRC1
Allele-specific binding is gain, not loss, on the alt allele

matrix.test: Allele-specific luciferase reporter of the ~500 bp element (G vs T) in Hep 3B2.1-7 hepatocytes, with and without mutation of the created C/EBP core

outcomes.outcome: T > G activity; abolished by C/EBP core mutation
T > G activity; abolished by C/EBP core mutation (indistinguishable here)
T > G activity but unaffected by C/EBP core mutation
T > G via loss of repression; direction may invert in repressor-high conditions

matrix.test: Parallel siRNA knockdown of CEBPB vs CEBPA in hepatocytes, measuring endogenous SORT1 and allelic reporter activity
Allele-specific ChIP-qPCR for CEBPB, CEBPA and HNF4A in heterozygous liver cells
Base editing of rs12740374 G>T in an isogenic hepatocyte line and RNA-seq of SORT1/CELSR2/PSRC1

next_experiment: Side-by-side siRNA knockdown of CEBPB versus CEBPA in Hep 3B2.1-7 cells carrying the allelic reporter (and measuring endogenous SORT1): it is cheap and is the single test that distinguishes H1 from H2, while a complete absence of any allelic effect would also support the null.
